svg.title: Native Hive exposes execution and closure separately
svg.desc: The top row summarizes the tested stale-feedback case: original execution has one admission and zero acknowledged feedback; after controlled clock advance STI is nine, and reconciliation retires the stale effect without changing that execution. The bottom row covers separate applied-before-lost-reply and expired-before-execution tests, not one combined run. The actual authenticated native Programs 0.1 dispatcher selects the existing plugin. Prepared original-command mapping is private and persisted before step. Public parameter original_command respects the unchanged Hive credential guard. The response exposes execution status/reason, admissions, original counts/remaining, evidence pending/state, feedback closure counts and version. Private episode/task/support IDs, roots, snapshots, credentials and paths are excluded. Seven native cases include four process kills; both attention providers are exercised. Same public reconciliation identifier replays the same observation; use a new one for newer progress.
svg.text: Native Hive exposes execution and closure separately
One unique admission · zero feedback applied
Recover the original receipt after expiry or
decay, even when current STI has reached zero.
Hive can finish the action with zero admissions
and zero reservations. Those counts stay
Public done / committed means the action returned. Detail reports execution, evidence and feedback closure.
